# Zylora

> Zylora is an AI-assisted website builder and business workspace for independent businesses, teams and creators.

## Canonical public resources
- Product: {{APP_URL}}/
- Website templates: {{APP_URL}}/templates
- Approved freelancers: {{APP_URL}}/freelancers
- Resources and guides: {{APP_URL}}/blog
- XML sitemap: {{APP_URL}}/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: {{APP_URL}}/robots.txt

## Product facts
- Users can create a website from a detailed business brief or start from a premium template.
- Public websites support structured manual editing, AI-assisted editing, managed image replacement, publishing, custom domains, SEO/GEO metadata, leads and appointments.
- AI-created information architecture follows the user's business brief rather than subscription-plan page limits.
- Template and AI-created sites remain editable before publishing.
- Zylora public plans are Free, Starter, Growth and Pro/Managed. Starter is ₹799/month in India or US$9/month internationally; Growth is ₹1,799/month in India or US$19/month internationally; Pro is sales-assisted “Get in touch”.
- The embedded AI Sales Assistant is unlimited on all plans and does not consume AI credits or lead credits. Builder/editor/generation AI uses AI credits; lead-delivery actions use lead credits.

## Indexing boundary
Only public product, resource, freelancer and intentionally published website pages are discovery content. Dashboard, editor, account, checkout and private API routes are not public knowledge sources.
